requirements.description: User wants the building located near public transport. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
The building will be a university student residence, so universities and schools must be nearby. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.
Energy class C or better (A1 to A4, B, C), as requested by the user. Area, capacity, location and transport requirements are not energy-related and are excluded.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, mapped to the total surface_area threshold. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied. The CDP/PNRR student-residence purpose, energy class C, and public transport proximity are not reference columns and were not used as filters.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the ESTATES table to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the location, ascending. No LIMIT, and no comune_code predicate was added.
